secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Used server-side by the AI schedule parser (/api/schedule/parse-ai) and the AI copilot (/api/ai/copilot). Optional: the app boots and every other feature works without it, but those two AI endpoints return an error until a real key is provided.
